title: Shorten Agent Instruction Guidance
summary: Generated AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md EVE guidance is now a concise Markdown section without HTML comment markers. The installer still recognizes older comment-managed blocks and upgrades them to the shorter version.

risks.title: Snapshot recorded without a locked Plan
risks.mitigation: The repository had unrelated dirty .eve/cache state before this task, causing declare_plan to refuse the request. The implementation scope and validation are recorded explicitly.

decisions.title: Use a concise Markdown section instead of HTML comment markers
decisions.rationale: The agent instruction files are token-sensitive. A short visible Markdown section satisfies the workflow guidance while avoiding comment markers in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.

decisions.title: Preserve legacy comment-block upgrade support
decisions.rationale: Existing repositories may already have versioned HTML comment blocks, so the installer still detects and replaces those safely.

validation.command: git diff --check -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md cmd/eve/instructions.go cmd/eve/instructions_test.go cmd/eve/main_test.go
